question: How sensitive are the three original Arg1/Il6 library descriptions to inclusion of the frozen mixed fibroblast/macrophage class?
decision: Limit or retain the core-class description according to fixed inclusion sensitivity; do not reassign mixed cells to a true lineage.
strongest_rival: Unknown preparation/batch and class selection, ambient RNA and mixed cells may explain library differences without an identifiable genotype or within-state biological effect.
discriminator: Compare original core to core plus the frozen mixed label using the same two QC masks and equal library weights; retain all original labels in target-count attribution.
exposure_record: Original R1 endpoints, annotation, composition and source outcomes exposed. No mixed-inclusive target summaries calculated before this freeze.
biological_unit: Coculture preparation/animal pooling and biological independence are unknown; report libraries, with cells nested within libraries.
nesting_and_overlap: Slices and wells nest in source patients or donor combinations; cells nest in libraries. Numeric library suffixes do not prove preparation pairing. Source panels and deposited data are reused published evidence, not independent replication.
population_and_selection: All 12519 frozen barcodes, unchanged five labels and two QC masks. Other/unassigned remain in attribution; core eligibility required in both inclusion sets.
contrast: Original three comparisons by two overlapping cell sets, two overlapping QC masks and four frozen metrics; all four crossed-library differences.
endpoint: Primary library mean log1p per10000; detection fraction, mean per10000 and pseudobulk CPM companions. Per-label raw count totals/detection/share of all retained target counts.
methods: Frozen saved-table joins only; NumPy aggregation with independently reread CSV/math.fsum verification and equality checks against saved core summaries. No raw matrix reload.
missingness_and_exclusions: Original core eligibility mandatory, unchanged QC masks and labels. Undefined shares when total target count is zero; empty-label detection undefined. No failed core rescued by mixed cells.
multiplicity: All 48 contrast rows and 192 crossed differences, no tests/CI/bootstrap or outcome-driven selection.
precision_basis: Technical source checks do not estimate population precision.
interpretation_limit: Library-level assignment sensitivity; neither true lineage reassignment, validated contamination bound nor biological uncertainty. Unknown preparation, ambient signals and composition confounding persist.
stop_rule: Stop after fixed inclusion/attribution tables, figures and independent arithmetic. No relabeling, new classifier, correction of ambient RNA or external expression extraction.
amendment_reason: New owner-authorized extension. Original analysis unchanged.
